source_behavior.summary: CommentsManager exposes localized BackToExplorer navigation from the currently loaded site Comments Manager to that same site's Explorer.
source_behavior.success_semantics: navigation only; no WordPress, local persistence, queue, cache, schedule, provider, or secret mutation is performed

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: CommentsBackToExplorerControl is mounted only by RouteElement for route.key === 'comments' on the real tenant Comments workspace.
laravel_adaptation.destination_derivation: tenant slug and active_site.id are taken from the authenticated server FrontendContext; active_site must agree with the same-origin tenant-qualified api.comments contract before navigation is exposed

runtime_path: authenticated browser session enters /tenants/{tenant}/module/comments?site={site} under auth and tenant.context
TenantBootstrap requests /tenants/{tenant}/context?site={site} through same-origin apiRequest credentials
tenant.context resolves an active membership for the authenticated user and the route tenant slug
the context endpoint requires tenant.view and resolves the optional site through tenant-scoped Site::query()->findOrFail
only a tenant-owned resolved site becomes active_site and receives the matching api.comments contract
the control requires the existing Comments workspace capability, preserving content.view and comments.read connector scope
the control independently requires Explorer's sites.view permission and respects any explicit disabled explorer capability state without inventing a nonexistent explorer API contract
the control verifies api.comments origin, encoded tenant slug, active site id, and absence of query/fragment overrides
the destination is derived from tenantUrl(context.tenant.slug, '/explorer') plus the server-derived active_site.id
navigation reloads /tenants/{tenant}/explorer?site={site}; TenantBootstrap then rereads /context?site={site}, reapplying authenticated tenant and tenant-scoped site resolution
navigation reports no domain mutation or fabricated success state

authorization.session: Laravel authenticated same-origin session is required by server routes/context; no local fake sign-in is introduced

tenant_isolation.active_tenant_resolution: tenant.context binds the route tenant to the authenticated user's active membership
tenant_isolation.active_site_resolution: server-side tenant-scoped Site::query()->findOrFail on the authenticated context request

runtime_semantics.input_validation: active_site.id must be a positive safe integer; comments authority must be a parseable same-origin exact path with no query or fragment override
runtime_semantics.csrf_write_path: not applicable; this canonical control issues navigation only and no write request
runtime_semantics.persistence: no Site, Comment, Connector, or tenant persistence change
runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread: destination TenantBootstrap rereads the tenant context and selected site from the server after navigation
runtime_semantics.truthful_success: there is no success receipt or status; the link is absent whenever authority or capability is inconsistent
runtime_semantics.retry: no domain retry is introduced; only normal read/context loading behavior applies
runtime_semantics.cancellation: not applicable; navigation starts no background/domain operation
runtime_semantics.secret_exposure: none; the control consumes only tenant slug, numeric site id, permissions/capability metadata, and a same-origin API path
runtime_semantics.wordpress_connector_safety: no WordPress mutation or Connector write is performed by the control
runtime_semantics.provider_safety: no AI, billing, mail, or other provider call is performed
runtime_semantics.audit_or_receipt: not applicable because no domain mutation occurs

proof: exact canonical operation marker and source-equivalent Back to Explorer navigation
foreign tenant, foreign site, foreign origin, query override, and fragment override fail closed
tenant.view, content.view, sites.view, comments.read, explicit Comments disable, and explicit Explorer disable fail closed
guest context is unauthorized and foreign direct site ids return not found
authorized destination rereads authoritative tenant/site context
no API mutation, CSRF write, queue/cache/scheduler, secret, WordPress mutation, Connector write, provider call, demo data, or fake success

terminality.reason: The source BackToExplorer behavior is implemented as a tenant-qualified, server-authority-derived, read-only Laravel Comments control. It requires authenticated tenant context, Comments and Explorer authorization boundaries, rejects mismatched/foreign site authority, rereads server context at the destination, exposes no secrets or mutation surface, and fails closed whenever the required authority is absent or inconsistent.
